notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Cheering Fanatic.
description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to name "Sculpting Steel".
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Cheering Fanatic. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
